notes: Better builds and more honest numbers. The search now also tries ability trees made for spells and for main attacks (for most damage and balanced goals), tries more weapons with the best gear it found, searches the gear again around crafted items, and plans the ability tree more widely for the best builds. In our tests some builds came out much stronger (one assassin build +53%, one +12%). Accuracy fixes: mana steal and life steal only work on main attack hits, so spell-only builds no longer count them (in "most damage", only for the time you main-attack between casts), and Mage's Paradox mana refund now counts like on Wynnbuilder. Spell numbers that relied on mana steal or life steal go down to what you'd really get. Searches take longer, especially with crafted items, and deep searches at high levels (80+) are much slower for now; making those faster is next.
